name: o-json: decide what to do with unsaved edits

actions.label: Quit after reviewing the warning
actions.caption: y confirms quitting with unsaved edits. Choose it only when you are finished with this edited view; the source file remains intact.

actions.label: Keep working on the edited document
actions.caption: esc closes the quit confirmation and keeps the edited view. Return to your work when you still need to inspect or export it.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
